method: Blind rating of 40 shuffles (mixed harmonies and modes) on a 5-point scale: 3+ means 'I'd use this as a starting point'. Add one entry per rated shuffle: { "seed": number, "mode": "dark"|"light", "harmony": "auto"|..., "rater": string, "score": 1-5 }. Target: at least 70% rated 3 or higher.
